message.content: {"note_claim": "L'Allemagne a atteint la finale de la Coupe du monde 2002 et ses adversaires avant la finale étaient classés en dehors du top 10 FIFA (Arabie saoudite 34e, Irlande 15e, Cameroun 17e, Paraguay 18e, États-Unis 13e, Corée du Sud 40e).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Runners-up Germany [...] Saudi Arabia (34) [...] Republic of Ireland (15) [...] Cameroon (17) [...] Paraguay (18) [...] United States (13) [...] South Korea (40)", "reason": "The page confirms Germany was the runner-up (reached the final) and lists the exact pre-tournament FIFA rankings for each opponent mentioned in the note, none of which are in the top 10."}

parsed.note_claim: L'Allemagne a atteint la finale de la Coupe du monde 2002 et ses adversaires avant la finale étaient classés en dehors du top 10 FIFA (Arabie saoudite 34e, Irlande 15e, Cameroun 17e, Paraguay 18e, États-Unis 13e, Corée du Sud 40e).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Runners-up Germany [...] Saudi Arabia (34) [...] Republic of Ireland (15) [...] Cameroon (17) [...] Paraguay (18) [...] United States (13) [...] South Korea (40)
parsed.reason: The page confirms Germany was the runner-up (reached the final) and lists the exact pre-tournament FIFA rankings for each opponent mentioned in the note, none of which are in the top 10.
